newsitem.title: DUBAI: Kuwait arrests nine on drugs, weapons charges.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait arrests nine on drugs, weapons charges.

text.p: Kuwait arrested nine people accused of dealing drugs and the illegal possession of firearms, the official Kuwaiti news agency KUNA reported on Monday.

An interior ministry statement quoted by KUNA said the men had been caught with 3.5 kg (7.7 lb) of hashish and an unspecified amount of heroin in addition to pistols and a machine gun in their possession.
Kuwait's parliament last year passed a law introducing the death penalty for some drugs crimes to curb what parliamentarians called the spread of narcotics use in the Gulf state.
